TalkParam.1400000: The fallen leaves tell a story.
TalkParam.1400010: The great Elden Ring was shattered.
TalkParam.1400020: In our home, across the fog, the Lands Between.
TalkParam.1400030: Now, Queen Marika the Eternal is nowhere to be found,
TalkParam.1400040: and in the Night of the Black Knives, Godwyn the Golden was first to perish.
TalkParam.1400050: Soon, Marika's offspring, demigods all, claimed the shards of the Elden Ring.
TalkParam.1400060: The mad taint of their newfound strength triggered the Shattering.
TalkParam.1400080: A war from which no lord arose.
TalkParam.1400090: A war leading to abandonment by the Greater Will.
TalkParam.1500020: The call of long-lost grace speaks to us all.
TalkParam.1500030: Hoarah Loux, chieftain of the badlands.
TalkParam.1500070: And Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-knowing.
TalkParam.2001500: Don't worry Torrent, fortune is on his side.
TalkParam.2001510: We found him here, after all.
TalkParam.2001520: One of his kind is sure to seek the Elden Ring.
TalkParam.2001530: ...Even if it does violate the Golden Order...
TalkParam.2003010: In search of the Elden Ring.
TalkParam.2003020: Emboldened by the flame of ambition.
TalkParam.2003050: Let it be Margit the Fell!
TalkParam.2004000: Mighty dragon, thou'rt a trueborn heir.
TalkParam.2004010: Lend me thy strength, o kindred.
TalkParam.2004060: I am the lord of all that is golden!
TalkParam.2007000: It's been a long while, Morgott.
TalkParam.2007010: Long and hard didst thou fight.
TalkParam.2007021: Spurned by the grace of gold.
TalkParam.2007060: To be granted audience once more.
TalkParam.2008020: Thou didst me good service, Serosh.
TalkParam.2008070: Now I fight as Hoarah Loux!
TalkParam.2014010: You must abide alone a while.
TalkParam.2014530: To the birthplace of our dynasty!
TalkParam.2021020: What is thy business with these thrones?
TalkParam.2021050: The twin prodigies, Miquella and Malenia.
TalkParam.2021100: Thy kind are all of a piece.
TalkParam.2021111: Pillagers. Emboldened by the flame of ambition.
TalkParam.2021130: Have it writ upon thy meagre grave:
TalkParam.2021140: Felled by King Morgott! Last of all kings.
TalkParam.2024520: I'll soon birth thee anew, a sweeting fresh and pure...
TalkParam.2025510: Have no fear, I will hold thee. Patience...
TalkParam.2025520: Ye will be countless born, forever and ever.
TalkParam.2025530: Upon my name as Ranni the Witch.
TalkParam.2025541: Mother's rich slumber shall not be
TalkParam.2025570: Of the last Queen of Caria,
TalkParam.2025580: And the majesty of the night
TalkParam.2026010: My flesh was dull gold...and my blood, rotted.
TalkParam.2026020: Corpse after corpse, left in my wake...
TalkParam.2026060: And I have never known defeat.
TalkParam.2027510: The scarlet bloom flowers once more.
TalkParam.2030031: Join the Serpent King, as family...
TalkParam.2030041: Together, we will devour the very gods!
TalkParam.2039100: General Radahn is cursed ever to wander.
TalkParam.2039101: Before we begin, allow me to paint you the full picture.
TalkParam.2039110: Eaten from the inside, by Malenia's scarlet rot, his wits are long gone.
TalkParam.2039120: Now he gathers the corpses of former friends and foes alike, gorging on them, like a dog.
TalkParam.2043010: Burn, for the sake of the new Lord.
TalkParam.2043020: Thank you. For guiding me here.
TalkParam.2043030: The one who walks alongside flame,
TalkParam.2043040: Shall one day meet the road of Destined Death.
TalkParam.2043060: I hope you will become Lord. Lord of each and all.
TalkParam.2048000: Now wilt ye serve, each and all.
